notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, tightened contracts, and aligned dependencies to execution flow. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Clarified schema fields (generated_at, ttl_seconds, file_count, sha256_root) and alignment with brain_snapshot persistence format.
Expanded evaluation logic to explicitly include TTL config, filesystem hash recomputation, and mismatch handling paths.

change_log.note: Ensure contract depends on schema + logic

change_log.value: Clarified enforcement behavior: block, warn, or trigger regeneration via existing manifest_generator without adding new pipeline steps.
Expanded test scope to include stale edge cases, partial hash mismatch, and pipeline enforcement paths.

stories.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define and standardize schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at (ISO timestamp), ttl_seconds, file_count, and sha256_root hash; ensure compatibility with manifest_generator output and brain_snapshot persistence structure.

stories.title: Implement Manifest Freshness Evaluation Engine
stories.description: Implement logic to evaluate manifest freshness using TTL expiration, generated_at age, and SHA-256 hash comparison by recomputing current filesystem state via manifest_generator; classify results as fresh, stale, or regenerate_required.

stories.title: Expose Manifest Freshness Status via Internal Service Contract
stories.description: Provide an internal callable service returning freshness status (fresh, stale, regenerate_required) and metadata (age_seconds, ttl_seconds, hash_match, last_generated_at) for use by orchestration components without introducing new public APIs.

stories.title: Integrate Freshness Enforcement into Execution Pipelines
stories.description: Integrate freshness checks into dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo to enforce pre-execution validation, triggering existing manifest regeneration or blocking execution when stale, without introducing new pipeline stages.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness and Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema integrity, TTL expiration, hash mismatch detection (full and partial), and enforcement behavior across dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo execution paths.
